chain_summary.pattern: Family amusement / redemption / claws / racers / shooters / fighters. Official map-slug rhythm games (DDR, PIU, maimai, Bemani) are rare at TW; 2018 ZIv note that many TW/Fun House DDR machines were removed. 2022 PH community music lists only named TW X-Site Festival Alabang (PIU Prime 2 + GFDM V8, separate ZIv id 387), TW Robinsons Galleria Ortigas (PIU Fiesta), and TW Robinsons North Tacloban (DDR X3) - none of those exact branches are clean matches for this shard's 39 sids.
chain_summary.note: Converted Kinect Dance Cabinet is recorded as games:other where present; it is not official DDR/dance_evo.
